steps.name: A Message from Lumen Alliance Headquarters
Preparing to Meet Iris
steps.objective: 1. Talk to [Yuran], then go near 「Sanctum of the Covenant」. 2. Meet [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」 and talk to her.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It has been a while, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Yuran.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Everyone is grateful for the way you have resolved Eastland's difficult troubles and continued to move forward.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: On behalf of everyone in Lumen, allow me to thank you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. I only did what I had to...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That is why I called for you. There is something I must tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. Please go ahead.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Lady Iris is no longer in Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She said Lady Gaia had called for her, then left without warning a few days ago. Or, more precisely, disappeared.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She was certainly different from before. Until then, she had been a human girl, but now she seemed to exist on another level...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was this what Lady Gaia meant when she said I'd be able to meet Iris?)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I heard you recently received a divine revelation. If it isn't too forward of me, may I ask what it said?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia was looking for someone to meet her at the appointed time. I reached her then, so she blessed me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And she said I would be able to meet Iris soon.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Perhaps your meeting with Lady Iris is itself the divine revelation Lady Gaia ordained.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: A divine revelation usually foretells fate through a god, but its meaning depends on how one interprets it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then are you ready to meet Lady Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course. I'm always ready to meet her.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I see. Then I will tell you where she went. Lady Iris said you would understand once I told you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She will be near the place where you received Lady Gaia's blessing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I know where that is.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then I hope you and Lady Iris have much to share.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for helping Iris all this time.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Not at all. I only did what I should.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go see her. My work in Eastland isn't finished yet.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Travel safely.
(Yuran watches until %s is out of sight beyond Lumen's alliance headquarters.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ull, you should have come out to say hello to %s.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No, First Senior Sister.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: When that person first came here, many people did not fully trust them.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: But by resolving dangerous problems and earning everyone's faith, the adventurer has become indispensable.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You looked down on %s at first, but surely not anymore. You must feel it too.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: As for becoming a Champion now...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You needn't worry. I couldn't deliberately kill an ally instead of an enemy.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: All right. I understand. I'm going to check on the guild in the Training Forest. Will you come?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No. I'll take my leave...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Does he mean he could do it if they were an enemy? Surely not...)
(An unfamiliar energy comes from a narrow path behind the Sanctum of the Covenant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this it...? Similar to when I met Lady Gaia, but different in its nature...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris is waiting. Hurry. I'll finally be able to meet her.
(The place where %s met Gaia unfolds before the adventurer. It is clearly the same place, yet the wind, sunlight, and even the atmosphere feel unfamiliar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the Sanctum of the Covenant, but it feels different. Different from when Lady Gaia was here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Iris over there? Iris...
(As the adventurer speaks the name lingering on their lips, a girl appears within.)
(The girl, with her sweet, lively air, flushes at the adventurer's arrival.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, it's me. Welcome, %s...
(Iris reaches out and takes hold of %s, then steps closer and gently embraces the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know what to say or how to express it. Except to thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I... I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only...
(Iris wipes away her gathering tears and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I succeeded Lady Seres as the God of the Astral Realm, but I'm still human... I still have a human heart...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So as long as my power can reach you, as long as I have this heart, I'll act for you. And I'll be here for everyone who has cherished me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I won't go far away.
(As Iris finishes speaking, a mysterious light flows out and begins to fill the space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so bright...
(As the adventurer struggles to open their eyes against the radiance, Iris's voice reaches them.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Open your eyes now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...
(The light around Iris recedes, revealing a different form from the one she wore a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What should we talk about? This is actually our first time speaking face to face, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You said you met me in the Poison Mist Swamp, but I wasn't myself then. I should have greeted you...
(Iris gives a playful smile, then looks a little sad.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't mean to hide it, but I made you doubt. That alone makes me a bad person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, at one point, you nearly became something you never wanted to be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something I never wanted to be?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being that could not help but sin...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What? Wait, that's...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: An Agasura...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Before you and I could meet, a being that desires this world's destruction placed a curse on you, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Whether you wanted it or not, every time you encountered the destructive energy that being sought, your mind was eroded a little more, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's why you sometimes felt unlike yourself, or acted that way.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I wanted to protect you. My power was small, but I wanted to use it for you. To keep you from becoming that, %s, I erased your memories of those moments each time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Oh, so that's why my memories... And why I sometimes tried to act as though I weren't myself...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was the only thing I could do before I awakened...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If the corruption had continued for too many days, %s, you could have become something you never wanted.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being who attacked me and everyone else at someone else's command. That is why I asked Yuran to keep you from meeting me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. If I had been strong, if I had been a stronger being, you wouldn't have had to suffer like this, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right. Don't apologize. You protected me, Iris. It's all right. It was because I was weak...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Still, I'm sorry. For making you unable to remember Lady Seres... You should remember clearly now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I remember that day in Xenadia clearly. I won't forget you either, Iris. I promise.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The traces of power the Champions gave us belong to the ancient gods. With that power, I no longer need to keep training in the Training Forest.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have the strength to protect my own adventurer now. So I won't give you reason to misunderstand, or hide things from you. I promise.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And for all living beings, and for Lady Gaia, who worked so hard for me, I will rebuild the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: With the truths of the world Lady Seres taught me and Lady Gaia's help, I'm coming closer to the truth.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've learned about Deimos through our spiritual connection, Adventurer, but it still isn't enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. You can ask me for help.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The matter of Deimos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I already know about it. I'll see it through to the end. So you see your own work through, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you still need more of the Champions' power, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Only Lady Io and Lady Medea's powers remain...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please meet Lady Io first. Something seems to be happening that even she doesn't know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and find out.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. You can meet me here whenever you like, so please come and see me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will... I'll be back...
(Iris smiles brightly and waves. The light around her slowly approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This light is so warm...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which way do I go to reach Lady Io? The northern snowfields...? Mars was nearby. I'll ask Peonia there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But if I'd become something I never wanted, like a sinner, as Iris said... what would have happened?)
(Iris's light comes and goes. Opening their eyes at the Eidos checkpoint, the adventurer slowly sets off toward the next destination.)

steps.name: How to Reach the Snowfield
steps.objective:
1. Take the portal in 「Mars」 to enter 「Deborah Snowfield」.
2. Defeat [Deborah Ice Otter] and [Rampaging Ice Otter] in 「Deborah Snowfield」, then report to [Titi] in 「Deborah Snowfield」.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Welcome, %s. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has everything been all right in Mars?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Mars is fine, but there's been a little trouble in the nearby snowfields. %s, do you know the Debora Snowfields?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where Lady Io is...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: So you know. A few demons and monsters from the well must have gone that way. There was a bit of a commotion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Gerda hasn't asked for help, so its warriors must have handled it. I'm jealous...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: When I look at Mars, where we can't feel safe without hiring fixers...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Oh, sorry. Enough about me. What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to Gerda to meet Lady Io, but I didn't know the exact route, so I came to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mars is in the north, and so are the Debora Snowfields. They're close, aren't they?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Close, yes, but you'll have to take a long way around. The snowfield route is so rough that people rarely use it, and the old path has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Is that all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Keep going deeper in and you'll find a narrow path. Follow it around. Oh, did you see Veled on your way here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was thinking about the snowfields and came straight to Mars, so I didn't pass by where he stays. Is something wrong with Veled?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Since that incident, he's been disappearing for days at a time. I think that's what's happening again. When I ask, he says he wandered around watching people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could something be wrong...?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm sure it's nothing. It had better be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Veled still not allowed into town?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm trying to convince everyone, but I don't think Veled himself is ready yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Enough about that. You seem busy, so go on. And if any monsters get in your way, please deal with them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thanks for your concern, Peonia. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Yes. Take care.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: ...Whenever a god's messenger starts moving, I feel something big is about to happen...
(The path seems ready to send the unwary slipping or sinking into deep snow. The white landscape stretches endlessly ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Brr, it's cold. That wind cuts right through me. Whoa, I nearly fell...
(Far beyond the white snowfields, blue waves seem to draw the adventurer's gaze. Chunks of ice floating on the sea rock with the water's movement.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never expected to see a view like this in Eastland... Huh, what's this? A sign? Let's read it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: "Welcome to the Debora Snowfields. If the journey to Gerda becomes dangerous, or you feel you might freeze to death, be sure to stop for Titi halfway along and wave a carrot!"

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A carrot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Waving a carrot suddenly reminds me of Noel. Let's find that rest stop first.

steps.name: Through the Blizzard…
steps.objective: Defeat [Ordinary Snowman] and [Nameless Wendigo] in 「Deborah Snowfield」, then report to [Galette] in 「Gerda」.

lines.text: (A lone figure stands near the middle of the snowfields: a boy with ears like a fox's, twitching alertly.)
You there. Identify yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: One moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's wave the carrot hanging from the tree.)
Oh... Did you read the sign?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It said Titi would be here, and to wave a carrot.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I'm Titi. Welcome. Rest here and you'll feel better soon. There's purifying energy around me, so you'll recover quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Purifying energy?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: If you choose the right snow and ice from the Debora Snowfields, they can quickly cleanse even contaminated things. But you look familiar... No! Like someone I've heard a lot about.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Oh! Oh! Oh!

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Are you... Are you on your way to meet Io?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am... Did Lady Io tell you?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Io said an older friend told her that someone interesting-looking would come someday! Someone who looked like this and that.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: She asked me to guide you if I saw you here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone interesting-looking, like this and that...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lady Io's older friend? Interesting-looking? If she heard it from Lady Shynic, that must mean me...)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I heard you're the hero who appeared in Eastland like the wind and took on the Deimos cult so bravely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm no hero, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly introduces themself to Titi.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Feeling better now? You should be warmer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, you're right. The cold seems to have eased.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I've been doing this for a long time. A few hundred years, maybe...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A few hundred years?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Long ago, when the Deimos cult attacked our village, I fled and ended up here. I'm one of the Kali people. You know Medea, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lady Medea too...

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Medea rebuilt the village somewhere after that, but I couldn't find it. So Io passes along my regards when she visits now and then.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Shall we go? Follow me. If you stay close, you won't feel the cold as much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Titi, how do you know so much about that?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I'm not an ice spirit, but there's a spirit I call my big sister in the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit? The kind of spirit I know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A village with all sorts of beings... Well, Eastland is that kind of continent.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Sometimes, if you step in the wrong place, you'll fall right into the snow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! You should have told me that befo—

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: You fell in faster than anyone who's ever come here. Wait! I'll pull you out somehow!

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: See? You should have listened to me. Otherwise, you might have frozen to death!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, we handled the monsters, and you pulled me out of the snow, so I think I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Hehe, thank you. Oh, there's Galette. Shining as brightly as ever today! Hello!

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: You're the only one who appreciates my face, big brother. Is the person with you a traveler?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes. They came to meet Io.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Could this be the guest? Lady Io said she thought someone would arrive today, and she's been busy preparing.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Hello. I'm Galette, the flower upon the glittering snow, and I run the Snowflower Inn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. It's nice to meet you. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Wow, now that I've heard your name, I know! The hero who smashed the Blue Spear Guild! Madeleine told me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... There were circumstances. But something smells delicious.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I was making a variety of dishes for the villagers and our guests.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come back after meeting Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Of course you must. There's nowhere else for you to stay, %s. Delicious food, comfortable beds, a place you'll never want to leave after your first visit.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Galette, you're amazing as always.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Since you're here, eat before you go.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Oh, shall we? %s, you're feeling much less cold now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it is warmer in the village. How strange.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: It's the special energy of Gerda. Hehe. Go have a meal, like Galette said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I? I am hungry. Then thank you for the food.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I've just prepared Galette's Special Debora Risotto, simmered with my special seasoning and mountain goat broth. Enjoy!
(The adventurer spends a little time at the inn, enjoying Galette's delicious food.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Whew, that was good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know Debora's mountain goat meat was so delicious.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Uncle Valdrick alone has eaten an incredible number of those goats.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Valdrick...

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: That mage beside us ate almost as much as Uncle Valdrick... Oh, he's heading that way. Does he have business with Io?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: %s, let's go too. I'll guide you all the way to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Titi.

steps.name: The Shaking Icicle Prison
steps.objective: Defeat [Argos] in 「Icicle Prison」 and listen to the story of the past. Then turn in the quest to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.text: (A mansion in the distance is covered in a delicate layer of snow and ice, thin enough to shatter at the lightest touch.)
(Before it, a graceful woman as lovely as a snow crystal speaks with a young mage.)
Then I'll be going, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Feta. You've been a great help.
(The young mage Io called Feta finishes speaking and leaves.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Io, I brought your guest.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Titi.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: %s, I have work to do, so I'll head back to the snowfields. Talk with Io. See you later too, Narin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take care, Titi.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Farewell, Titi. If you are %s...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. %s, the adventurer of Lady Iris, the new god of this world...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I felt the spirits' energy changing even in the Debora Snowfields. Was that your doing, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. Lady Iris has changed now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You felt it too, Lady Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm a Champion, so I can't help feeling such things... Oh, right. I have a request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I appreciate the courtesy, but just call me Io. I prefer it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please do so. Io may look cold and be rather headstrong, but she is a kind child in her own way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, all right. But you are... a spirit? Oh... I've never seen a spirit in a human village before.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe. Everyone is surprised at first. I am Narin, a spirit of water and ice.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io's parents found me collapsed in the snowfields, rescued me, and took me in. I have lived here ever since.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: They cherished me, giving me a name that means 'a child descended from the heavens.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a lovely name.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Thank you. Please feel free to use my name as well.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Enough introductions. There's something to discuss. If the goddess sent you here, she must have meant for you to help me, right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And the goddess must need my help, too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Here, take this. It's ice from Debora. No ordinary ice. Keep it until it melts, and my power will pass to the goddess on its own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Io. What do you need my help with?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The snow and ice of the Debora Snowfields are melting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't notice any melting on my way here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You probably couldn't see it, %s. Alongside what is visible, there are parts you can't see... You know what I mean by the reverse side, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After Goddess Gaia saved Eastland, Debora became a snowfield. The land holds a special purifying energy, and the beings here live upon that energy...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But the snowfields are melting. You might think melting snow and ice would return Debora to its warm, ancient state, but that isn't what will happen.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This place has escaped the power of binding because Debora's snow and ice have protected it. Especially Echo Spring...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The energy that forms the snowfields is very strong there. A spirit friend of mine lives there. She asked for help because some power was melting the spring.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But... I haven't seen her in a while. At some point, she changed. She won't let me in anymore...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Don't worry too much. There must be a reason.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But a spirit friend...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: As humans may be friends to spirits, so spirits may be friends to humans. Just as I am...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Echo is an ice spirit at Echo Spring in the Debora Snowfields. I have never met her myself. They say many water and ice spirits dwell there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If spirits live there, couldn't you go and meet them too, Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: But I do not know where it is. I once found it, yet could not enter. And now I no longer know its location.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Just as Narin says. I was the only one allowed in... Narin? Ah, you felt it too.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The Icicle Prison is shaking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That place beneath the village is a prison...? Is something inside?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Come with me, %s. I'll explain on the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, stay here as always. Please.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Have no fear. Lady Narin the spirit's blessing shall protect the village.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll never get used to the way she talks. %s, are you ready?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm ready. Let's go.
(As they pass the sturdy bars built into a wall at the edge of Gerda, a powerful chill unlike anything in the snowfields surrounds them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You must have felt it too, %s. This prison holds fanatics afflicted by binding. I'm purifying them with the Debora Snowfields' energy.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's already been hundreds of years...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: At first, they sincerely believed in something. They probably didn't know it was wrong. Their hearts froze, and they lost all sense of themselves...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Someone uses them. They kill other living beings, gather their life force, and offer it to someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Some of those who now answer only to Weiss's messages must be someone's family or friends.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I... I wanted to save them. My father, my mother...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's nothing I can do for the dead. But I hold on to a little hope for those who survived and became monsters.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Maybe it's selfish of me... But shouldn't they see the sunlight again someday?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someday, they will.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's why I'm helping the new goddess gain power. I can't do it alone. Echo said she'd help, but I haven't received much...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, we need to deal with this first. As the snowfields holding the spring's power melt, the Icicle Prison seems to be melting too. Is the spring badly polluted?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This place was built from ice harder than any other... I can't believe it's melting.

lines.speaker: 무언가의 울음소리
lines.text: GROOOOOOAR!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That roar is definitely... Wait, who's there?
Lady Io, Lady Io. Please save me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Liriope? Why are you here? You should be with Echo at Echo Spring. And what are you saying?

lines.speaker: 리리오페
lines.text: Please, please save me. I am sorry. I am sorry that is all I can say right now. Though I released him, it was not my will. Please forgive me.
(Liriope turns into a droplet and disappears with a clear plop.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That spirit talks like Narin... What is she planning? And it felt as though she was waiting for Io and me.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Liriope? Save you? Why?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If she means him... I can't believe she woke him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The yeti Argos. The sinner who made Gerda a living hell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gerda's hell...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: He's a monster who no longer recognizes anyone. We have to bring him down. I'm stronger than I was then, and now you're here too, %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Whew. Let's go. Finish this quickly and get out!
(In the deepest part of the prison, the enormous icicles built to contain a massive being lie shattered.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Argos, come out.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Grrrooo... Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Do you even remember me?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Io... Grrrr...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I remember the hell you made of Gerda.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Grrrrrr...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly was Gerda's hell...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I hate telling this story, but I will.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yetis lived in one part of the Debora Snowfields. My father and Uncle Argos were friends. Like Narin and me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The Deimos cult hunted the yetis. Those who fought together against them returned under the power of binding.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Argos no longer recognized the villagers who had fought beside him and buried them in ice. And my father... my mother...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The survivors barely managed to capture and imprison Uncle Argos. That was all they could do. Back then, no one could kill a yeti with such monstrous strength...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I was young, but I grew stronger and built this prison to keep him from entering the world again.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I curse you, Uncle. But I never wanted you to become this. This is all what Weiss wanted!

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Grrrr...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, can you do this?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. I can. I have to. If I don't, then never... Huh?
(The wall before Io splits, and icicles fall from it.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The ice is melting faster...? Is something wrong with Narin?
(Io gathers the cold surrounding her and casts a barrier over the prison.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If the prison collapses, Gerda will be in danger... But I have to face Uncle Argos...
(Argos lifts a huge ice club and attacks Io, only to recoil in surprise at %s's counterattack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That yeti doesn't seem to recognize me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: (Such a precise counter to Uncle Argos's attack...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll fight him. Io, keep the Icicle Prison from collapsing!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right! Be careful! Uncle Argos is furious now.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: GRAAAAAH! GRAAAH! GRAAAAAAH!
(Argos's roar shakes Io's barrier. The cracks in the Icicle Prison's walls widen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll have to try...
(As %s's strike connects, Argos loses his strength and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to bring him down properly. Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Grrrr... Ugh... Ugh... Why am I... Who are you? Weaver? Where is this...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weaver? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: The one who was with the goddess... Or not? Why am I here? I was... Why am I attacking you?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Inachus and I... I...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Argos?!

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I...o? Is that you, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The binding broke?
(With disbelief on her face, Io approaches Argos, then stumbles in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: It really is you, Io. Still so clumsy, falling over... Here, get up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, it's dangerous.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's all right, %s... Step back.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You're still you, Uncle. You haven't changed... You haven't changed, but the binding...
(Io takes Argos's hand and rises. Emotions she has held back for centuries surge within her.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Io...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't remember any of it... I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Tell me what happened while I was under the binding. I'll accept all of it...
(Argos looks at Io with resigned eyes.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The hell you made of Gerda...
(Io wipes her tears and looks up at Argos. Sitting before him, she recounts the years that have passed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a terrible story... Why do the Champions have to endure such trials...?)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's everything...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I fell under the binding, failed to recognize my friends, and committed terrible sins. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But when did you and Father meet Weiss? He's the only one who could bind you like this...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: We were pursuing Deimos fanatics who had appeared in the snowfields when we found a spring. Beside it lay a spirit who had lost her memories.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: The young spirit could not remember why she was there, and she was afraid. So Inachus took her back to the village.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Later, we discovered that part of the binding's power was being created and spread from the spring. While investigating, a terrified spirit begged us for help.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Her wings were frozen. Hearing her plea, we wanted to learn why we could feel both purifying energy and the power of binding in the spring.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Inachus, who could communicate with the spirit, promised to restore her wings.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: But one day, she led us deeper into the spring. Following her was a mistake. Her eyes no longer held the look we knew. Her entire presence had changed.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Her attack froze us, and that was when we met Weiss. Then...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I tried to do something, but it was no ordinary spirit's attack. She already possessed an alien power.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Uncle Argos, what did that spirit look like?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: She was tall, and one of her frozen wings was half missing. It was definitely Echo, guardian of Echo Spring...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The one Io said was her friend...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo? Echo did that?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: That is where my memories end... I'm sorry, Io... I will pay for my sins. Kill me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...All right. If that is what you want... And as Gerda's representative, it is something I can do...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I had already prepared myself for this...
(Before Io can finish, an enormous, ominous force flies toward them. She senses it and creates a great ice shield, deflecting the attack.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Someone must want to freeze to death. Bringing the power of binding all the way here? How dare you...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is definitely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, that attack...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, come out. Come out and talk.
(At Io's words, ice springs from the ground like droplets and takes the form of a woman.)
(The spirit's frozen wings are beautiful, but an ominous power emanates from the broken left wing.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Echo? That spirit...
(The instant Argos tries to approach Echo, dozens of enormous, sharp icicles erupt from his body.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: (Argos's head drops lifelessly to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Argos?! Echo?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, what have you done?!

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Help me...
(Echo looks at Io with a faint smile.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Io, save me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Echo?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Listen to me... I... I...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You told me you couldn't leave Echo Spring. So what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And you're spreading the binding I hate. Now you're asking me to save you? What on earth...? You won't even let me in.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Io, save me...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Save me. Come to Echo Spring... The path to the spring is open for you...
(Despite her words, Echo creates enormous shards of ice as though ready to attack Io.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is wrong with Echo. Io will be in danger at this rate... Huh?)
(The sharp icicles Echo created melt and fall to the floor. Echo herself turns into droplets and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Save me. Save...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, what is happening?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hah... hah... I can't breathe. I'm suffocating. U-ugh... ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: W-we have to get out quickly. The binding's energy fills this place... Echo left it behind...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, stay with me! I'll carry you out!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, Narin! Let's get to Narin!)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s! I've been waiting! Quickly, come here!
(The moment Narin sees them, she sends an enormous droplet toward the Icicle Prison's entrance.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That should keep the evil power from escaping the Icicle Prison.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, I would like to know what happened...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, tell Narin...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. I just want a moment to sort things out in my head.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll tell her. Narin, what happened in the Icicle Prison was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Narin what happened in the Icicle Prison.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: These spirits, Echo and Liriope, did such things while asking you to save them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Narin...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: And even attacked with the power of binding...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: We can learn nothing here. We must go there and investigate...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin... Stay here.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: No. If this concerns spirits, I can help more than a human. This place is safe. Io, do you doubt my power?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That isn't it. I'm only saying you can't approach Echo Spring.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: ...Perhaps I might discover what I have wanted to know.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When did you last try to enter?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: About fifty years ago, perhaps... I tried to enter the area around the spring, but a barrier stopped me. You were the one who took me there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Narin and that spirit Liriope really did look alike...)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, I am going too. May I accompany you? %s, would you permit me to join you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't mind, but Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go to Echo Spring. I'll lead the way. Let's meet Echo.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...If Uncle Argos was telling the truth, then Echo is hiding something. I need to know what.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I have a duty to know, for the snowfields and the village.
(Cold flows from Io's fingertips as she speaks. She struggles to steady her energy and keep her composure.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Icicles born from the power of binding burst from his entire body. Those icicles killed yetis and people.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even I couldn't withstand an attack like that. Shynic might be all right, but...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That terrifying woman...
(Narin's face suddenly pales.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is nothing. Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hahahahaha...
(Narin seems to have fallen into a sudden panic.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's been so long, yet just hearing Shynic's name does this to her. Snap out of it, Narin!
(Io grabs Narin and shakes her vigorously.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Aaaaaah! I'm dizzy! Ioooo...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Given the situation, we need to hurry. There's no need to stop and pray for Uncle Argos.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, you're coming with me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. I knew you would. Then let's go to Madeleine.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Madeleine is one of our village's warriors. A truly excellent archer.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. Let's go to Madeleine... and meet Echo...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if things aren't all right, I have to be. I don't know what Echo is hiding, but if it threatens Gerda...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll have to destroy it in the goddess's name... Whew. Though I don't know whether the goddess would wish that or not...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Shall we go?

steps.name: A Past Trapped in Ice
steps.objective:
1. Defeat 「Echo」 in 「Echo Spring」 and obtain the <Ice Wings of Bondage>.
2. Return to [Madeleine] to view a memory, then turn in the quest to [Madeleine].

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Lady Io? Lady Narin? What brings you...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everything's been all right here?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Madeleine, has anything happened?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: A little. I still don't really know whether there's a spring here, but I've kept watch as you instructed.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: The water's flow and energy have definitely changed...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You're as capable as ever, Madeleine. Here, Galette packed you a lunch. Eat it when you have time.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Galette has packed plenty of all your favorites.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: But who is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice to meet you. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Perhaps you've heard of this person, Madeleine.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: The one who defeated Randaine... Thank you. If you hadn't, he would have become even more of a monster.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Don't worry about it. You only did what you had to, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Madeleine's expression is complicated...)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Lady Io, are you going to the spring?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. But it will be different from before. Madeleine, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Please tell me.
(Io gives Madeleine a small piece of ice.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If this ice melts, go straight to the village and set my mansion on fire. Then take everyone to Mars immediately.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That will bring Uncle Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Lady Io, that means...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I'm here, and so is Narin. And we have %s, the goddess's chosen adventurer.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: At the very least, I won't let the people I love get hurt. You know what kind of person I am, Madeleine.
(Io grins and pats Madeleine on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel how strong her spirit is...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin. %s. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, the barrier seems to be blocking me. Before, it merely barred the way. Now it is rejecting me. Only me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, wait...
(Io reaches out and waves a hand. Sensing something, she looks displeased.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's changed... To keep only Narin out... %s, reach out here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, but what is here? Oh, this...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You can feel it even if you don't want to, can't you? This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... There's no mistaking it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, stay here with Madeleine, then. With you here, the snowfields and Gerda will remain stable... And if anything happens, go with Madeleine...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Enough words. Go and return safely.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Narin. %s, let's go. Follow me.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Return safely, Lady Io, %s.
(A narrow stream winds between the ice. The water in sight appears contaminated, stained an unfamiliar color.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Keep your wits about you. This energy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll be careful. Io, there are droplets ahead...
(As soon as they enter Echo Spring, the same droplets seen in the Icicle Prison rise from below.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's that spirit.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. The spirit called Liriope. She attends Echo... But don't take her lightly.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Liriope is a high-ranking spirit. Though she isn't at the level of Harmonia or Geis in the goddess's Inner World...
(The droplets slowly gather into Liriope's form.)

lines.speaker: 리리오페
lines.text: Lady Io, please forgive me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What exactly am I supposed to forgive? You still want to say this isn't your will?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her actions don't match her words. She looks ready to kill us... Io must know.)

lines.speaker: 리리오페
lines.text: It is not my will. All of this...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course. It would take great power to control a high-ranking spirit like you. But a god wouldn't mistreat spirits like this.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, come out. What are you planning?
(Ice leaps from the ground like droplets, surrounds Liriope as she tries to escape, and freezes her. One droplet slowly takes Echo's form.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Io, you came to save me.
(A moment later, Liriope's frozen body begins to crack, then shatters.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo? What have you done...?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Just as I hoped, Io. You came to save me. This isn't my will. But it's all right. There are other Liriopes to serve me, so it's fine.
(Echo smiles brightly and beats her wings. But the smaller wing cannot move properly, and she winces in pain.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Aaaaaagh... All of this... Save me. Save me... Come to the far end of the spring...
(Echo freezes as she cries out in pain. A moment later, she scatters like droplets and flows away into Echo Spring.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, think carefully. Liriope was afraid, but Echo wasn't. She was enjoying herself.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I know. She was pretending to be bound like Uncle Argos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can't let myself be fooled any longer. I still need to hear what Echo has to say, but...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go, %s. Echo Spring has many paths that loop back on themselves, so follow carefully. I'm the only one besides the spirits who knows the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's hurry. We don't know what that spirit will do...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If we follow the clear water...
(Where the clear water stops, purple-stained ice and water mingle, intensifying the sense of revulsion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo won't be able to deny it now. Two people who have suffered from this power are standing here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Shall we make her come out?
(A huge ice crystal blooms at Io's fingertips.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, you won't be able to endure this.
(Io waves her hand. The huge crystal shatters and scatters across the spring. As its fragments melt, sacred power spreads.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It feels like when I met the goddess.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's a mixture of things in it. Especially when purifying...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Aaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A spirit's scream...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, come out and talk.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Urrgh... Ghh...
(Ice crystals gather into Echo's form. She struggles to stand, wrapping her arms around herself in pain.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I'm happy you came to save me, Io. But you mustn't purify this place...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Then I won't be able to leave. This power is what lets me go outside.
(Echo grins, and the purifying energy vanishes without a trace. The ominous power grows stronger and forms an enormous icicle.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...What are you doing?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Thank you for bringing that child here too... I'll use all the power I've gathered to destroy her.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: The one who imprisoned me here so I could never leave...
(The enormous icicle slowly rises into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You can't mean...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, what is she talking about? What does that spirit mean...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So you're going to kill Narin?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: ...When that child dies, all the snow and ice in Debora will melt. Isn't that what you want too, Io? For Debora's living beings to be free of the snow and ice?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The power of binding has driven you mad.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I'm not mad. You're the one who mistakenly thought we were friends...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: When the time comes, that icicle will fall exactly where it should. Thank you, Io. For trusting me and coming all the way to your grave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Using trust as bait. You don't deserve to be called a spirit.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I don't care. I have to get out. I have to take revenge on those who imprisoned me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, hurry to the spring's entrance.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s? What do you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll bring that foolish spirit down somehow. Defeating her may be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something I need to do for Iris as well. So hurry outside, Io!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Hurry!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right. I'm counting on you!
(Echo quietly watches Io run. Then she turns toward %s's gaze.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: ...Soon this world will be gone. I'll escape before his will is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You're talking about Weiss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You aren't denying it, so I must be right. Then I'll give you a proper fight. At least I need to show you that you chose wrong.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: A mere human...
(As Echo opens her eyes, the power of binding around the spring intensifies.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Drawing this out will be dangerous. I have to finish quickly.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Aaaaaaah!
(The spirit's agonized scream echoes through the entire spring. True to the spring's name, the repeated sound seems to draw even the listener into her pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Give up, Echo.
(Echo sits on the ground, clutching herself in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's nothing more you can do. You know you were wrong the moment you chose to use binding, don't you?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I only wanted to go outside. All I did was tell the gods not to abandon this world. Why was I punished...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An ancient spirit? She certainly isn't ordinary...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you tried to use binding to escape?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Was that wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Using binding instead of a spirit's power? Don't you know what binding has done to Eastland?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I don't care if it's binding, as long as I can leave. The power Weiss gave me let me reach Gerda.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: With spirit power and binding together, I could take revenge on the one who imprisoned me... That's why I woke the bound Argos and waited for Io and that child to come!

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: You ruined everything! Cough, cough...
(As Echo screams, the ice wings on her back fall away.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: You ruined everything...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Argos wasn't lying... You deceived Io and pretended to be her friend all those years...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: He said I could escape if I used the power of binding. I only did what he told me...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I didn't know it would take away the people Io treasured...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Io, who cared for me so much...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Ugh... uuuugh...
(Echo trembles in anguish. The poisonous binding energy around the spring repeatedly gathers and scatters.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something's wrong. Something is wrong...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is going on?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Weiss, kill me! Just kill me!
(At Echo's cry, a great surge of water erupts from the stream and sends %s flying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Echo?! What are you...?
(With a crash, the enormous icicle hanging over the spring falls straight down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The icicle suddenly... Echo?
(Only broken shards of ice remain where Echo stood. The being who was Echo has vanished without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She definitely said Weiss... Weiss?
(Amid mist rising from the broken ice, the bearer of the ominous power slowly walks out.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It's been a while, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Foolish spirit... Even tormented by binding, she chose this for Io's sake...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you do?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I merely shared the power of binding long ago. The spirit used it, polluted the spring, and cast it upon the yetis and humans.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Those whose minds changed fought and killed one another, offering their life force to me. Does that answer your question?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What do you want? What is Azrael that makes you do all this?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A world loved by lives from another world... I, too, am slowly forgetting. Because of that contract...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Loosen your grip on your weapon. If you die here, the goddess will grieve. Are you all right with that?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: We'll meet soon in Avalon... I'll be waiting.
(Weiss smiles, and purple flames appear from nowhere. They envelop him, then vanish without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, all the ominous energy in the spring is gone. Because Echo disappeared? Or because Weiss did...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Deimos is going to appear in Avalon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, let's get out and meet Io. I can decide after that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what's that? Ah... Echo's wing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should take it out and show Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The icicle in the sky is gone.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Much of the ominous energy is gone too. But Lady Io, Lady Narin... I'd like to get out from between you now...
(Madeleine, caught between Io and Narin as they hold hands to maintain a barrier, raises a hand.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Weiss came and went while we were here.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: For him to come all this way and do nothing...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That wretched man plotted something and set it off, as always. I have some idea, but let's hear it from %s when the adventurer returns.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, the land is freezing again.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Should we call freezing normal...? It is normal for us, but...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Ugh...
(Narin looks up at the sky, then suddenly collapses.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I don't know why I'm like this. I feel weak, unlike usual...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I think I'm all right for now... Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, Narin! I'm back. Huh? Narin, is something wrong? The icicle should be gone...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What are you holding?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Io what happened with Echo and shows her the object that was Echo's wing.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo's ice wing. It's full of binding energy...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Perhaps this is...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what is it?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, may I use this object?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Will you be all right? Binding energy still remains in it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Nothing will happen. Please let me use it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right. Do as you wish.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: How can I help?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Wake us in about an hour. If someone doesn't fall asleep, use Debora's snow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does she mean, fall asleep?)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: All right.
(Narin unfolds a scroll and places Echo's ice wing on it. A moment later, the wing melts into tiny droplets that rise into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, what is this...?
(Io and Narin calmly lean against an icy rock side by side and close their eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm suddenly sleepy... I shouldn't fall asleep here...)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Don't worry. Close your eyes. It won't hurt. Lady Narin and Lady Io said it would be all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?
(Madeleine gathers a great armful of snow before %s, who struggles to stay awake. A moment later, an enormous snowball flies into %s's view with a solid thump.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Looks like you arrived safely.
(Io looks down at %s's fallen face and brushes away the snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what happened? It feels like something hit me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Your imagination, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My face is a bit too sore for that.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Never mind. You've been through things like this before, right? This will be similar. We're looking through someone's memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Oh... Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Io knows about those, too.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'm sorry, Io. I didn't know. I didn't know Echo's wing held memories of that time...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's all right. It can't be helped. Oh, %s. Just watch quietly now. Only watch. You'll understand everything...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When it's over, I'll curse Weiss all over again...
(Io and Narin meet each other's eyes, then look ahead. Their figures vanish without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Only Debora's landscape of white snow and ice remains. Then a familiar voice sounds across the snowfields.)
This... This isn't right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Echo's voice.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: ...This isn't me...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I only wanted to go outside. This isn't what I wanted.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Weiss, you ruined me...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: What I ruined was not you. It was other lives...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You knew from the moment you accepted another world's power.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: No, no. I... I...
(As Echo trembles in fear, enormous ice crystals appear around her. They fly toward Weiss as if to pierce him, but melt away before reaching him.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A curious spirit gazed into a rift in spacetime and became attuned to another world's energy.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Resenting another spirit who worried about this, she pierced that spirit's eyes with icicles and blinded her.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The Spirit King of Water and Ice learned of it and, in anger, banished the offender. Yet still caring for her, the Spirit King allowed her to remain in a certain place.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: That Spirit King once came here. The spirit pretended to repent, approached, and cast binding upon the visitor...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Stop...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The Spirit King barely escaped the spring, then disappeared. To find the vanished Spirit King and take revenge, the spirit used the humans and yeti who came to her.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Stop! Stop it! No...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: No. These are facts without a single lie.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I've seen many humans wear masks, but never a spirit. Were you trying to become Nemesis, goddess of vengeance?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: D-don't come closer...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Binding is the ugliest thing possessed by the lives of this world... And if that is now connected to me...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Go away!
(An enormous shard of ice erupts from the floor and shoots toward Weiss's heart, only to shatter before reaching him.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: ...I do not vanish just because some spirit tells me to.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Ugh... Ah... I can't move.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A spirit's beautiful wings...

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Wh-what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: These useless wings that can no longer fly...
(Weiss approaches Echo, seizes a wing, and bends it back. One frozen wing breaks apart.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaah!
(The spirit's agonized screams continue to echo through the spring, painful even to hear.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: How does it feel to be restrained by the binding you wanted? Now gather life force under that binding whenever I wish!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Just as you used Gerda's humans and yeti, who wanted to help you, and made them kill each other!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: And open your eyes when the time comes. Close them again when the time comes. Like the powerless goddess...
(Echo stops struggling in pain. With her eyes closed, she turns toward Weiss.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Yes...
(A blizzard fills %s's vision, gradually erasing the figures of Weiss and Echo.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How can something so terrible happen...? Why do the people called Champions endure these things?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, you're awake. Madeleine, put down that snowball.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Being hit with a snowball hurts more than you'd think. Please don't do that too often.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: What a shame.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's over now. Some of that weight has lifted, too. Don't let it trouble you too much.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll say it again. I'm sorry to my father and Uncle Argos, but I won't offer prayers for their souls. Even if they were victims...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo was headed for that fate anyway. She isn't worth discussing. She paid for her sins that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I merely learned something I hadn't known. Now I have one more reason to kill Weiss, don't I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Whew...
(Io lets out a short sigh carrying many meanings. Then she smiles faintly at Narin.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, I'm sorry. I thought all water and ice spirits looked mature, like Echo.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe. Such lovely words, you little wretch. Are you trying to freeze to death?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can freeze people too! I'm a Champion, after all!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, now you know what happened before you came to the village. How do you feel? Spirit King...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will happen to Narin now?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If nothing else happens, she'll keep living in our village. Right, Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, I have nowhere else to go. As Io says, I will remain in Gerda.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A god brought me to this village, so here I shall stay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. That sounds right.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: And thanks to Echo, I have found this scroll's purpose. I shall put it to good use.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thanks to Echo... I suppose we do owe her that. You're a Spirit King, after all. Right, Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Show proper respect, Blizzard Empress. Come to think of it, we are both royalty. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: ...Are you enjoying yourselves?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Madeleine's right. Your jokes aren't very funny, Narin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. You've given me faith.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did I seem untrustworthy before?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, nothing like that. Shall we talk back in the village?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What will you do, Madeleine?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I'll make a round of the snowfields, then change shifts. I'm a little hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madeleine, what about the lunch Galette sent?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I ate it all while waiting for you three. Several hours have passed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... The time...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It took quite a while this time. I thought it would be brief. Let's head back and talk there.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Return safely.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We will.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, let us return to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Madeleine.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes. Goodbye...

steps.name: Over a Delicious Meal
steps.objective: Finish talking to [Io] in 「Gerda」, then go to [Galette].

lines.text: (While Narin goes to ask Galette to prepare food, Io looks around.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I really can't give this place up. If Narin did what Echo did, I would do the same to her. She never would, of course, but if she did...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm only talking to myself. Don't mind me. Oh, %s, there was something you didn't see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo's wing showed something only to Narin and me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: She seems to have wanted me to destroy her. But Weiss wouldn't allow it. He said Echo had to use all the binding power...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That must be something that will happen in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Look at the sky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't see anything. Just clouds...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Wait, %s. Narin, please.
(Narin returns and nods at Io's words. A moment later, glittering ice crystals rise into the sky from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The ominous energy will cling to the crystals. Watch where they're going...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They seem to be flying south. South would be...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. Avalon, where Weiss is. Even the faint traces of binding left across the continent are gathering in one place.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Do you know what that means?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Deimos...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Something big enough to require all that power. Bringing Deimos into this world.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: He probably meant to use Echo to melt the snowfields this time, too. Once the living beings were contaminated, he'd convert them into binding power and take it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm sorry I left my work to you again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, with Echo and the binding power she carried gone, the spring's purifying energy is growing stronger.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I've come a little closer to the truth of binding, but this isn't enough. I'm going to develop it further.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't think simply breaking the binding, as when Uncle Argos briefly regained his senses, will be enough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Do not doubt Io. She may seem careless, but she is precise and persistent.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, I'll ask the goddess to reassign you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmph. How cruel.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Whew, enough. Listen carefully, %s.
(Just as Io is about to tell %s something important, Galette's voice comes from afar.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Lady Io, Lady Narin, %s! The food is ready! Come and eat!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We'll be right there, Galette!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, %s! For now, stop thinking. Let's eat, rest, and clear our crowded heads.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I was just getting hungry.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Then let us go.
(Io and Narin take %s by the hands and lead the adventurer toward the delicious smells from Galette's inn.)

steps.name: Sea of Baby's Breath
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] in front of [Galette] in 「Gerda」, then go to [Feta].

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Snowflower's food really is the best. I asked him to make something new especially for the gods' adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the meal. It was delicious. But I'm curious: Narin is a spirit. How can she eat human food so well?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: From the moment Io's parents took me in and I resolved to repay their kindness, I became able to eat like a human.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Mir sometimes brings unusual food, and the two of them eat it happily. He says an elder spirit on another continent prepares food specially for spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, how interesting.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Enough of that. Let's discuss what remains.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: 'We,' who are connected to divine power, will head to Avalon when that day comes. First, we'll need to tear open the boundary of binding that blocks it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is binding...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A kind of technique that allows the power of living beings to be formed elsewhere...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After long research, I learned something recently. While dismantling and combining magic stones made by the Deimos cult and the false Agasuras, I found something new...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The energy of destruction poured out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? The energy of destruction?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It felt as though gods were being annihilated, like in ancient times when the primordial being that sought this world's destruction appeared. As parts of my body began to split apart and vanish, Lady Gaia protected me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: She told me it was the power of the primordial being that seeks to destroy this world...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I wanted to thank her, but I can hardly feel Lady Gaia anymore. That's never happened before...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even when she slept, I could feel her presence in this world...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, the research stopped for a while, but I'll resume it. Even if I may encounter that destructive energy again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right now?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As you can see, I'm fine. And I have to be. For the goddess and everyone, not only for us, I will never fall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. And I won't leave everything to you. I've been preparing things. Uncle's heart, freed from binding, should be a useful specimen too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But when you say everyone, there's still...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about that. Miss Medea should be ready now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After all, Medea likes her big sister Io. Hehe, I bet she likes me more than Shynic.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It seems only natural that she would prefer Io to that terrifying woman.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Pretend you didn't hear Narin. Rest here for a few days, then go see Medea. You'll go in my name, so she'll welcome you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The witch who interferes with us should also be away from Eastland for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You know her. Daphne... The witches have been quiet, so I'm looking into it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...She used to work so well with Weiss. Now she's just watching again.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That isn't what matters right now. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Weiss comes first...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A witch...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, what will you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm asking about your plans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll go back to Iris and tell her what happened here. Then I'll wait to hear from you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right. I'll call for you when the time comes, so come to Gerda. Huh...
(Io looks puzzled as Feta approaches.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Feta, what is it? If it's about magic, come another time.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: No. I was waiting for you and the adventurer to finish speaking. I have something to tell the adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What an enormous spellbook... He doesn't seem like an ordinary mage...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't know what it is, but I hope it isn't serious. In a situation like this, when someone has something to tell a person like %s... Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hear what he has to say. Io, then I'll say goodbye here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right. See you later. Narin, say goodbye to %s and let's go. Feta, tell me about it later.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, take care, and please visit us again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Io. Narin.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Now, Adventurer, would you come over here?
(Feta sets his enormous spellbook on the ground and sits.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's a little heavy, so I'll put it down. Would you like to sit too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Your name was Feta, right? What is this about?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: (Grrrrowl.)
(Instead of an answer, a rumbling sound comes from what seems to be Feta's stomach.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm still an inexperienced mage. I have to eat a lot to replenish my mana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does he mean...?)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then I'll explain.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I am from the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Magic Bureau?)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You're startled as soon as you hear the affiliation. The bureau's reputation really is terrible.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You should hear people out.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm an apprentice mage working independently. I don't belong to any particular faction, but I joined the Etoile Allied Forces because I wanted to try something different.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Places like Lumen have plenty of mages, but other areas don't. So the allied forces sent me on a special assignment.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That's how I came to Gerda.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Though at the moment, I'm mostly just eating to replenish my mana.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: When Lady Io's research needs mana, I cast elemental magic for her, or make simple magical tools for the villagers.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: In Lumen, I also put mana back into faded gems for the mages of the Jewel School.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So what did you want to tell me? This long explanation makes me think there's something else.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I've talked too much. You're right, Adventurer. What I actually meant...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's about a certain witch. She came to me in person and asked if I'd become her servant. Inside the Silvaria Magic Bureau building, no less.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch? In the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's worth being surprised. I was surprised too. Why at the bureau...? I have nothing to do with witches...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: When I refused to serve her, she told me to give this to someone named %s if I ever met them.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: She said she'd find and kill me if I didn't, so I've kept it all this time.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: My life matters to me. Here, take it.
(Feta takes a slip of paper resembling a bookmark from between the pages of his spellbook.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I don't really know. She said that when the time came, that person would take it to someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did the witch look like?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I thought I saw her clearly, but she seems to have erased that part of my memory. All I can remember is seeing someone called Zephyros there.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I've delivered it now. Whew, that weight seems to be lifting... Ah, she really must have put a curse on me.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That witch really meant to kill me... I've been eating all this time to keep myself alive...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then I'll be going. I'm hungry... Cursed or not, I suppose a human still gets hungry. See you later, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that mage telling the truth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch who erases memories? Why did she give me this...? And what does it say...?
(The paper in the adventurer's hand bears these words in careful cursive.)
"A night someone has awaited for a long time. Apart from that night, another will come that someone else has awaited. If you care for your god, stand with us at the end."
